claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text, not a specific claim about these pallets' condition, size, or treatment; nothing in the photos confirms or denies it.

risks.risk: Photos show two different conditions (new light pallets in 0/1 vs weathered used pallets in 2); unclear which is actually for sale or if both lots are offered
risks.proof: A current photo/video of the exact stock being sold, with count, taken together

risks.risk: Wood treatment/certification (heat-treated, kiln-dried, ISPM-15 stamp) unknown, affects export/industrial use value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped block/corner showing HT or KD mark

risks.risk: Exact dimensions and load capacity not shown
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against the pallet or a spec sheet
risks.if_unproven: priced as smallest standard size with no rated capacity

risks.risk: Quantity available for sale is not stated
risks.proof: Seller confirmation or photo of full stack/count

risks.risk: Hidden structural issues (cracks, protruding nails, missing boards) not visible from the angles shown
risks.proof: Additional close-up photos/video from multiple angles including underside

risks.risk: Photo 2 pallets may just be reference/stock images, not the actual item being sold
risks.proof: Seller providing fresh photos of the actual lot with timestamp or location match
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified source, priced at worst-case condition shown

proof_requests: Clear, current photos of the exact pallets for sale, all at once, with a scale reference
Close-up of any stamp/mark on the block indicating wood treatment
Confirmation of quantity available and whether new or used condition is being sold
Close-up shots of corners/undersides to check for cracks, nail issues, or missing boards
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as wooden pallets, so it can be priced at worst-case (used, untreated, unverified quantity and condition) pending the listed proofs.
